# NEW 2026-11-22 v13.5 Worker 2: 16 Historical & Regional Peace Treaties Library (oe_pt_, 0 mainline slots, 0 vanilla overrides, 0 DLC hard dependencies). Generated by gen_v135_peace_treaties.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Peace-treaty execution effects (expecting scope:winner, scope:loser, and optional scope:war).

# --- 1. Westphalian Sovereignty ---
oe_pt_apply_westphalian_sovereignty = {
	scope:winner = {
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_pt_westphalia_winner_mod
			years = 20
			mode = replace
		}
	}
	scope:loser = {
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_pt_westphalia_loser_mod
			years = 20
			mode = replace
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_pt_westphalian_sovereignty_tt
			if = {
				limit = { uses_government_power = legitimacy }
				add_legitimacy = -10
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					religion = { has_religious_influence = yes }
				}
				add_religious_influence = -15
			}
		}
	}
	hidden_effect = {
		scope:winner = {
			if = {
				limit = { is_ai = no }
				trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_trty.3 days = 2 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# --- 6. True Physical Restitution of Plundered Masterpieces ---
oe_pt_apply_restitute_masterpieces = {
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = oe_pt_restitute_masterpieces_tt
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:winner = { exists = capital }
				scope:loser = {
					any_work_of_art_in_country = {
						art_is_priceless = no
						origin ?= { owner ?= scope:winner }
					}
				}
			}
			scope:loser = {
				ordered_work_of_art_in_country = {
					limit = {
						art_is_priceless = no
						origin ?= { owner ?= scope:winner }
					}
					order_by = art_quality
					max = 2
					check_range_bounds = no
					move_art_and_owner = {
						location = scope:winner.capital
						country = scope:winner
					}
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:winner = { exists = capital }
				scope:loser = {
					any_work_of_art_in_country = {
						art_is_priceless = no
					}
				}
			}
			scope:loser = {
				ordered_work_of_art_in_country = {
					limit = { art_is_priceless = no }
					order_by = art_quality
					max = 1
					check_range_bounds = no
					move_art_and_owner = {
						location = scope:winner.capital
						country = scope:winner
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	scope:winner = {
		add_prestige = 15
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_pt_restituted_pride_mod
			years = 10
			mode = replace
		}
	}
	scope:loser = {
		add_prestige = -10
	}
	hidden_effect = {
		scope:winner = {
			if = {
				limit = { is_ai = no }
				trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_trty.1 days = 2 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# --- 7. Celestial Cefeng Investiture ---
oe_pt_apply_celestial_cefeng_investiture = {
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = oe_pt_celestial_cefeng_investiture_tt
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:loser = {
					can_make_subject_of = {
						target = scope:winner
						type = subject_type:tributary
						ignore_war_limitation = yes
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { exists = scope:war }
				scope:loser = {
					make_subject_of = {
						target = scope:winner
						type = subject_type:tributary
						war = scope:war
					}
				}
			}
			else = {
				scope:loser = {
					make_subject_of = {
						target = scope:winner
						type = subject_type:tributary
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	scope:winner = {
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_pt_cefeng_suzerain_mod
			years = 20
			mode = replace
		}
	}
	scope:loser = {
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_pt_cefeng_tributary_mod
			years = 20
			mode = replace
		}
	}
	hidden_effect = {
		scope:winner = {
			if = {
				limit = { is_ai = no }
				trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_trty.5 days = 2 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# --- 14. Silver Indemnity Schedule (bounded safe transfer) ---
oe_pt_apply_silver_indemnity_schedule = {
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = oe_pt_silver_indemnity_schedule_tt
		scope:loser = {
			add_gold = {
				value = country_economical_base
				multiply = -1.5
				max = -25
				min = -400
			}
		}
		scope:winner = {
			add_gold = {
				value = scope:loser.country_economical_base
				multiply = 1.5
				min = 25
				max = 400
			}
		}
	}
	scope:loser = {
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_pt_silver_indemnity_loser_mod
			years = 15
			mode = replace
		}
	}
	scope:winner = {
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_pt_silver_indemnity_winner_mod
			years = 15
			mode = replace
		}
	}
	hidden_effect = {
		scope:winner = {
			if = {
				limit = { is_ai = no }
				trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_trty.7 days = 2 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# ==============================================================================
# Dev Panel Page 91 Verification Helpers (Country scope, silent execution)
# ==============================================================================
oe_pt_pick_dev_target_country = {
	save_scope_as = winner
	if = {
		limit = {
			any_neighbor_country = {
				is_rebel_country = no
			}
		}
		ordered_neighbor_country = {
			limit = { is_rebel_country = no }
			order_by = country_economical_base
			max = 1
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = loser
		}
	}
	else = {
		ordered_country = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { this = scope:winner }
				is_rebel_country = no
			}
			order_by = country_economical_base
			max = 1
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = loser
		}
	}
}

oe_pt_dev_open_ledger = {
	trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_trty.8 }
}

oe_pt_dev_test_westphalia = {
	oe_pt_pick_dev_target_country = yes
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:loser }
		oe_pt_apply_westphalian_sovereignty = yes
	}
}

oe_pt_dev_test_straits = {
	oe_pt_pick_dev_target_country = yes
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:loser }
		oe_pt_apply_kuchuk_kaynarca_straits = yes
	}
}

oe_pt_dev_test_cartaz = {
	oe_pt_pick_dev_target_country = yes
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:loser }
		oe_pt_apply_abolish_cartaz_monopoly = yes
	}
}

oe_pt_dev_test_restitute_art = {
	save_scope_as = winner
	if = {
		limit = {
			any_neighbor_country = {
				any_work_of_art_in_country = { art_is_priceless = no }
			}
		}
		ordered_neighbor_country = {
			limit = { any_work_of_art_in_country = { art_is_priceless = no } }
			order_by = num_works_of_art
			max = 1
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = loser
		}
		oe_pt_apply_restitute_masterpieces = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			any_country = {
				NOT = { this = scope:winner }
				any_work_of_art_in_country = { art_is_priceless = no }
			}
		}
		ordered_country = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { this = scope:winner }
				any_work_of_art_in_country = { art_is_priceless = no }
			}
			order_by = num_works_of_art
			max = 1
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = loser
		}
		oe_pt_apply_restitute_masterpieces = yes
	}
	else = {
		add_prestige = 15
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_pt_restituted_pride_mod
			years = 10
			mode = replace
		}
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_trty.1 days = 1 }
	}
}
